name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain = AI/battle, descriptor = execute_ai_offensive_spell). No Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects purpose: dispatched execution of the AI-selected offensive spell.
purpose: Execute the offensive spell the enemy AI selected (reads the ai_best_spell_* globals), gated by ai_best_spell_score >= 6.
logic_summary: Fetches the spell effect entry for data_fd2_battle_ai_best_spell_id. Derives aoe_flag from pSpell[6] (ctx_flag==0 -> (pSpell[6]==0)?1:0, else pSpell[6] directly). Gate: if ai_best_spell_score < 6 return 0. Otherwise: pan cursor to caster; compute AOE targets at (ai_best_spell_target_x,y) with shape pSpell[4] into target_buf -> n_targets; obfuscate tile map + 200ms delay; set anim_phase = pSpell[4]+2; animate tile cast effect; anim_phase=0; composite frame. Cast split: if spell id < 10 AND game_speed_flag==0 -> fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence (basic cast); else load_status_effect_sfx + indirect call data_fd2_battle_spell_handler_table[id]() + play_and_free_status_effect_sfx. Then collect dead-char drops -> n_drops; composite frame; play death anim and mark dead; process drop entries (target = ai_best_physical_target_idx); composite frame; pending_xp_credit=0; anim_phase=0; return 1.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-character index of the casting unit (enemy AI actor). Passed to fd2_pan_cursor_to_char and fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence. Callers thread their own caster_idx in.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residue; matches sibling executors (fd2_execute_ai_item_use) and caller param names.

params.name: ctx_flag
params.semantics: AI-context/team flag threaded from the dispatchers (fd2_attack_action_dispatch passes its ctx_flag; fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher case 11 passes 'team'). Selects how the spell AOE field pSpell[6] is interpreted: ctx_flag==0 -> AI usage passes (pSpell[6]==0) as aoe flag; else passes pSpell[6] directly.
params.reason: Matches the name already used in callers (ctx_flag) and the sibling fd2_execute_ai_item_use; no address residue. Accurately names its role as the context selector for AOE-field interpretation.

returns.semantics: 1 if the spell was cast; 0 if the score gate (ai_best_spell_score < 6) failed and nothing was done. Both AI dispatchers discard the value (they re-check the score themselves).

comment_original_issue: Source comment was accurate but thin: it stated only the score<6 gate and 'dispatch via handler table or basic cast sequence', omitting the load-bearing details that explain the two params (ctx_flag's AOE-field interpretation) and the precise cast-split condition (id<10 AND game_speed_flag==0).
notes: Two callers: fd2_attack_action_dispatch (C23 score path / spell wins) and fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher case 11 (smart-caster path), both thread caster_idx + ctx_flag(team). Ghidra plate comment is already a detailed superset consistent with the refined understanding, so it was left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none). Spell-id < 10 = basic offensive spells (火炎..咒殺, ids 00h-09h per fd2-knowledge); ids >= 10 (碎岩/地震/裂地 + summon/special) go through the handler table. Global names verified byte-identical between Ghidra decompile and src.
